name: @routemarket/work-desktop
description: Local-first desktop workspace for RouteMarket workflows, projects, agents and browser tasks.
author: PX Labs

scripts.prebuild: corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-worker-core build
scripts.predev: corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-worker-core build
scripts.predev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-worker-core build
scripts.pretest: corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-worker-core build
scripts.pretypecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @routemarket/work-worker-core build
scripts.dist:win: node ../../scripts/check-release-environment.mjs --platform win32 && node ../../scripts/write-release-manifest.mjs --check-source --artifact-dir ../../release && corepack pnpm run build:release && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../../scripts/verify-windows-signature.ps1 -ArtifactDirectory ../../release -Arch x64 && node ../../scripts/prepare-update-metadata.mjs --artifact-dir ../../release && node ../../scripts/write-release-manifest.mjs --artifact-dir ../../release --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.dist:win:dir: corepack pnpm run build:local && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:mac: corepack pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg
